item.title: Veer 1.0.3
item.description:
Veer 1.0.3 测试版 · Test build

  • Agent 侧边面板：每一页右侧都能直接和 AI 对话，“问 AI”不再跳转页面；工具栏 ✦ 或 ⌥⌘I 开关，⌘N 随时新建对话。 / Agent side panel: talk to the AI beside any page, and “Ask AI” no longer leaves the page. Toggle it with ✦ in the toolbar or ⌥⌘I; ⌘N starts a conversation anywhere.
  • 概览顶部新增提问栏；窗口较窄时概览卡片自动上下排列。 / An ask bar at the top of the overview; overview cards stack in narrow windows.
  • 名字里看不出地区的节点，按服务器 IP 自动识别地区（离线，可右键手动改）。 / Nodes whose names show no region are placed by their server's IP, offline; right-click to correct.
  • 节点很多的策略组，菜单按地区分成子菜单。 / Large groups split their node menus into regions.
